Niccolum Sulphuricum.

Sulphate of Nickel. NiSO4. Trituration.

Clinical.─Headache. Neuralgia, periodic.

Characteristics.─J. Y. Simpson cured with Ni. s. periodical headaches of very severe character. Hale used with success the 2x trit. in periodic neuralgias of malarial origin.
